description: Search every capture held for one school, across all of its catalog folders, not only the pages playlist_policy_open selected. Use it when a designation, award rule or note is not in the manifest's sections. Give unitid and query: plain words, or a code such as SI. Words are matched as one phrase, without regard to case; a query of 2 to 4 capital letters is matched as a whole token in its own case, so SI does not match SIGN or basic. Returns up to 25 matches, the pages with the most hits first. Each match gives the capture_file exactly as playlist_read and the save checks name it, its source_url, its character count, how many hits the page holds, and a snippet of about 200 characters around each hit, up to 5 a page. The text searched is the same cleaned text every source quote is checked against, so what you find can be quoted verbatim: read the page with playlist_read (unitid, and section page:<capture_file>). Read-only.

unitid.description: The school, by its IPEDS UNITID
